I bought dog food.
The batch was faulty because the food smelled bad. I went to three stores, always the same problem.
They told me that if I changed the bag and the same problem occurred, they wouldn't be able to exchange it.
I bought the same product, but from a smaller package and a different batch. I opened the bag to smell the difference between the two packages. They admitted there was a difference (so much so, that the dog wouldn't eat the faulty one) and told me they would report it. However, I wasn't refunded for the product, nor was I given an option to return the previously purchased product. I should also add the lack of empathy and competence on the part of both employees. They were as shoddy as the batch itself.

Arcaplanet on Viale Certosa is a must-have for pet owners. The store is huge, very well-organized, and offers an incredible selection of brands, from veterinary lines to more sophisticated ones. I really like how the departments are organized, making shopping quick and intuitive. The staff is always smiling and ready to offer advice on diet or the best accessories. A must-have in Milan for pet care!

March 2026, I entered the store while two girls were eating chips at the checkout. Obviously, they had no way to say hello with their mouths full. The store is tidy and well-stocked, but train the staff better. It always seems like we, the customers, are bothering them.
August 2022, 1 star for the staff. Even when they see you at the checkout, they don't come over. They don't have the proper training for the products or how to interact with customers. The store is well-stocked and worthy of a 4-star rating. It offers many brands and many different products, and it also has parking.
